ruklee-unreachable-unchecked.name: unsafe fn unreachable_unchecked
ruklee-unreachable-unchecked.rule: Calling `unreachable_unchecked` is undefined behavior if this code is reachable.

ruklee-maybeuninit-assume-init-initializ.name: unsafe fn assume_init
ruklee-maybeuninit-assume-init-initializ.rule: The contained value must be initialized before calling `assume_init`.

ruklee-option-unwrap-unchecked-is-some-r.name: unsafe fn unwrap_unchecked
ruklee-option-unwrap-unchecked-is-some-r.rule: The option must be `Some`; calling `unwrap_unchecked` on `None` is undefined behavior.
